# nvEncodeAPI.h

NVIDIA's NVENC API header, unmodified, as published in FFmpeg's
[nv-codec-headers](https://github.com/FFmpeg/nv-codec-headers), tag
`n12.1.14.0` (`include/ffnvcodec/nvEncodeAPI.h`).

- API version 12.1: runs on NVIDIA drivers from 531 on. The driver's own DLL
  (`nvEncodeAPI64.dll`) is loaded at run time from System32; nothing is linked.
- Licence: MIT, stated at the top of the header itself, and compatible with
  Nitshot's GPL-3.0.
- SHA-256: `dbdaa8bcbc2b9325bd24bc68b36170a8432411518040e8d4c8421608cf217425`
